## RESOLVED via Gerrit — rebar-debug report (Phase 2 complete)

**Problem.** CLI `rebar search` / `rebar ready` returned `[]` at exit 0 against an absent or
present-but-unusable store, masking a broken store as "no results" — diverging from the hardened
library reads.

**Proven root cause (runtime, real binary).** `_cmd_search` (`reads_cli.py:541`) and `_cmd_ready`
(`:470`) called `search_state` / `ready_states` **directly with no readiness gate at all**,
bypassing the hardened chokepoint `_reads._tracker` → `store_is_usable`. Census (absent / broken /
mid-clone / valid-empty): CLI printed `[]` rc 0 for **all four**, while the library
`rebar.search`/`rebar.ready` RAISE "not initialized" for the first three and return `[]` only for
valid-empty; `store_is_usable` returns False/False/False/True. So `rebar ready` told an agent "no
ready work" when the truth was "store is broken."

**Defect origin.** `caused_by = aefe-614a-2631-4117` (rapt-dreadable-dromedary), close-class
`regression`. Unmet-obligation / missed-consumer-update: rapt-d (commit `5fb693345b0c`, 2026-08-28)
hardened the library chokepoint + write gate to `store_is_usable` and created the "reads reject a
present-but-unusable store" obligation; the CLI consumers were never updated. Date test: the
`search_state`/`ready_states` direct-call lines were introduced 2026-06-24 (commit `051b82836bf6`,
the CLI/reads split — correct-at-the-time). Per rebar-debug Step 3 the origin is the obligation
creator, not the correct-at-the-time consumer; a whole-file blame would mis-name `051b8283`. Mirrors
`be80`'s deliberate divergence-from-blame.

**Test.** `tests/unit/test_reads_cli_search_ready_gate.py` (new) — drives both arms against absent /
broken / mid-clone / valid-empty stores asserting observable exit code + output, plus a structural
guard pinning the `store_is_usable(tracker)` gate on both arms. Proved legitimately RED first (7
failing on the wrong `[]` rc 0), GREEN after (9/9). Mutation check (sandbox-exec): re-seeding the
defect (removing the two gates) returned it to RED; restoring → GREEN. The test has teeth.

**Fix.** Added `if not store_is_usable(tracker): print("… not initialized …"); return 1` before the
`ready_states` / `search_state` calls in both arms — the exact predicate `be80` (change 2412)
applied to `list`/`session-logs`. Reuses the authority predicate; invents nothing. Contract:
absent + unusable → rc 1 "not initialized"; valid-empty → `[]` rc 0 (unchanged), matching the
library. AC-1 design question resolved **strict** (owner decision).

**Scope & safety.** Caller-dependency sweep: `_cmd_search`/`_cmd_ready` are called only by the CLI
dispatch registry; no in-repo caller relies on rc-0-`[]` for a broken/absent store. Restoration
(aligns CLI to the library authority), not creation — no new command/capability. No new dependency
(`store_is_usable` already imported). No existing test weakened (only a new test file added).

**Siblings (Step 7).** Axis 2 parity census over the CLI read registry
{show, list, deps, ready, search, next-batch, validate, session-logs}: `list`/`session-logs` gated
by `be80`; `ready`/`search` **fixed here**; `show`/`deps`/`next-batch` already fail closed (rc 1,
runtime-verified); `validate` is a tolerant health-check surface (sibling of the cited-tolerant
`summary`/`list-descendants`, `test_error_envelope.py:17`) — N/A. No MISSING slot remains: `ready`
and `search` were the last ungated state-reporting reads. Axis 1 (construct sweep) N/A — the defect
is an *absence* of a gate, not a recurring construct.

**Residual risk.** 8 pre-existing local-host test failures (`test_atomic_completion_close.py`,
`test_rebar_repo_isolation.py`, `test_tracker_footprint_cli.py` — git `show-ref`/`origin.git`
plumbing) reproduce on pristine `origin/main` with my change reverted and PASS in CI (all Verified
legs green) → **accepted**: local git-environment discrepancy, unrelated to this change, not a
regression.

**Replication.** Real `rebar search zzz` / `rebar ready --output json`: absent/broken/mid-clone →
rc 1 "ticket system not initialized"; valid-empty → `[]` rc 0. Original report no longer reproduces.

**Landed.** Gerrit change 2422 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2422), merged as
origin/main `db15bb2c94e5`. Votes: LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 1 non-blocking advisory: the structural
guard asserts on source text — intentional, mirrors `be80`'s class guard), Verified +1 (CI success),
0 unresolved. eb64 conflict check: DISJOINT (touches `_engine_support/reads_cli.py` + new test, not
eb64's `_cli/`/`_store/`/`_commands/`).
